newsitem.title: CANADA: Molson says talks with Miller advanced.
newsitem.headline: Molson says talks with Miller advanced.

text.p: Molson Cos Ltd said on Wednesday that talks with Philip Morris Cos Inc unit Miller Brewing Co to buy out Miller's 20 percent stake in Molson Breweries were at an advanced stage.
"The talks are fairly advanced," Molson spokesman Paul de la Plante told Reuters. "There are a lot of issues that have been discussed, but there are a lot of significant issues still outstanding."
He said Molson's partnership agreement with Australian beermaker Foster's Brewing Group Ltd stipulated that Molson must share the purchase of Miller's stake with Foster's.
Molson and Foster's each own 40 percent of Molson Breweries and Miller owns 20 percent.
De la Plante would not disclose any financial details of the talks, but said that Molson had plenty of cash on hand to acquire the stake.
"We have approximately C$680 million in the bank," de la Plante said.
